baseline.method: Full selected GCL with Yu LP, trim/fill and five refinements; independently reproduced with documented numerical compatibility and exact cold continuation

metric_definitions.joint_piece_accuracy: Mean exact coordinate AND physical quarter-turn agreement for each public-index tile after the common alignment.
metric_definitions.oriented_neighbor_accuracy: Fraction of all actual target-grid nearest-neighbor pairs with exact directed displacement and correct physical orientation of both endpoints after the same alignment. Count every true seam once.

alignment: One common global C4 acts on both coordinates and cumulative quarter turns; exists one k for which all required metrics pass. No independent per-metric alignment.
threshold_rationale: Require at least95% complete fragment poses and95% physically oriented true neighboring relationships, independently chosen before cleaned code. Both source baselines are1. This task-specific discrete recovery standard permits different inverse algorithms and full global C4 equivalence. It does not demand arbitrary solver trajectories or parameter identity.
reference_role: Actual known forward-acquisition fragment positions and cumulative inverse quarter turns; not a method reconstruction.
